title: IRAH: Hierarchical Agentic Tree Search for Retrieval Pipeline Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.30167v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimizing Information Retrieval (IR) pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) requires jointly selecting structural components and numerical hyperparameters under limited evaluation budgets. We introduce the Information Retrieval Agentic Harness (IRAH), which combines Language Agent Tree Search for IR (LATS-IR) with offline meta-learned initialization. LATS-IR performs UCT-guided hierarchical search, first exploring macro-structural pipeline choices and then refining numerical parameters, with natural-language reflections to guide subsequent mutations and provide inspectable search traces. We evaluate IRAH on three in-distribution benchmarks and one out of-distribution benchmark to assess generalization under distribution shift. Under the same meta-learned initialization, LATS-IR outperforms TPE on two of three in-distribution benchmarks, with gains of up to 6.4%, and remains competitive on the out-of-distribution benchmark.

translated_title: IRAH：面向检索流程优化的分层智能体树搜索
translated_abstract: 优化用于检索增强生成（RAG）的信息检索（IR）流程，需要在有限的评估预算下联合选择结构组件和数值超参数。我们提出了信息检索智能体框架IRAH，它将面向信息检索的语言智能体树搜索（LATS-IR）与离线元学习初始化相结合。LATS-IR执行由UCT引导的分层搜索，首先探索宏观结构层面的流程选择，然后细化数值参数，并通过自然语言反思来指导后续的变异操作，同时提供可审查的搜索轨迹。我们在三个分布内基准和一个分布外基准上评估IRAH，以考察其在分布偏移下的泛化能力。在相同的元学习初始化条件下，LATS-IR在三个分布内基准中的两个上优于TPE，提升最高达6.4%，并在分布外基准上保持竞争力。
tldr: IRAH将UCT引导的分层智能体树搜索与离线元学习初始化相结合，在有限评估预算下联合优化RAG检索流程的结构组件与数值超参数，性能最高超越TPE达6.4%。
en_tdlr: IRAH combines UCT-guided hierarchical agentic tree search with offline meta-learned initialization to jointly optimize structural components and numerical hyperparameters of RAG retrieval pipelines under limited evaluation budgets, outperforming TPE by up to 6.4%.
